title: HushVault Extension Container v1
description: Bounded namespaced extension mechanism. Root and record schemas are closed; future data is allowed only inside a bounded namespaced `extensions` object. `criticalExtensions` identifies extensions required to interpret the vault safely: unknown critical extensions fail closed and preserve bytes; unknown non-critical extensions are preserved canonically through updates. Extensions cannot replace or weaken required fields, algorithms, limits, or lifecycle rules. Byte/depth bounds are enforced at parse time (Phase 3).
